column4: Visit note | 2025-07-13 04:00 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Hafsa Islam, 78, female. Mrs. Islam reports she has no specific symptoms, but notes that her father had a heart attack at 55 and high cholesterol was found on a routine test. She is a retired civil servant, and this checkup was prompted after a relative's heart attack in Mymensingh. She has Essential hypertension. She denies chest pain, dizziness, or palpitations. Examination shows LDL cholesterol 5.9 mmol/L, BP 148/96 mmHg, pulse 81 bpm, weight 45 kg. Heart sounds are dual and lungs are clear. Assessment: Dyslipidaemia. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only, no new medicine was prescribed at this stage. She was advised to reduce fried food, red meat, and ghee, walk 30 minutes daily, and aim to lose 3 kg. Follow-up in 3 months with a repeat lipid profile.

Visit note | 2025-07-13 04:30 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Masud Talukder, 50, male. Mr. Talukder describes brittle nails, getting breathless on the stairs, and constant tiredness. He is a farmer, and his symptoms worsened after a long spell of poor meals while living alone in Kushtia. He has no known comorbidity. He denies bleeding, fever, or weight loss. Examination reveals haemoglobin 7.8 g/dL, BP 118/77 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 80 kg. Conjunctivae are pale, and chest is clear. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only, no new medicine was prescribed at this stage. He was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and avoid tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.

Visit note | 2025-07-14 10:30 AM | Dr. Mahmudul Hasan, Cardiology | Patient: Karim Khan, 71, male. Mr. Khan reports he has no active symptoms, but high cholesterol was found on a routine test and his father had a heart attack at 55. He works as a homemaker, and this investigation was prompted after a relative's heart attack in Sylhet. He has no other comorbidity. He denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or dizziness. Examination notes LDL cholesterol 6.0 mmol/L, BP 125/81 mmHg, pulse 73 bpm, weight 79 kg. Heart sounds are normal. Assessment: Dyslipidaemia. Plan: tests ordered before starting treatment, and no new medicine was prescribed today. He was advised to reduce fried food, red meat, and ghee, walk 30 minutes daily, and aim to lose 3 kg. Follow-up after the test results are ready.

Visit note | 2025-07-14 03:30 PM | Dr. Towhid Alam, ENT | Patient: Jubayer Matubbar, 61, male. Mr. Matubbar explains he has frequent sneezing fits and itchy eyes. He is a construction worker, and his symptoms became worse since road construction began near his home in Savar. He has Essential hypertension. He denies fever, earache, or breathing difficulty at night. Examination shows about 7 sneezing fits a day, BP 148/90 mmHg, pulse 80 bpm, weight 88 kg. Nasal mucosa appears pale and boggy, and throat is clear. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis. Plan: lifestyle and self-care advice only, no new medicine was prescribed at this stage. He was advised to avoid dust, wear a mask when cleaning, and wash bedding weekly. Follow-up in 1 month.
